buildGuide.author: Kay
buildGuide.summary: S15 'Skeletal Warrior Minions' (updated 2026-09-15): Skeletal Warriors Reapers + Deathgrip + Bloodless Scream; variants Early Game Army (no uniques) and End Game Warriors (Undercrown, Bloodless Scream, Deathgrip, Blood Moon Breeches, Pact of Bone; aspects Hellbent Commander, Reanimation, Hewed Flesh, Heavenly Strength); Black Shroud charm set + The Furnace; 100% minion attack speed for Cult Leader; Army of the Dead ultimate. No dedicated leveling section; recent comments criticize inconsistencies.

activities.name: Kurast Undercity
activities.whatItRewards: XP orbs per Attunement (Jade Epiphany node doubled in S15); Tribute of Refinement = masterworking mats incl. Forgotten Souls (added S15)
activities.tips: Default leveling/paragon route from ~lvl 25; unlock Jade Epiphany in Undercity War Plan; Baal's Splinter of Destruction modifies it

activities.name: Infernal Hordes
activities.whatItRewards: Dense XP via Damnation stacks; Spoils of Materials chest = Obducite + Gem Fragments (S13 info)
activities.tips: Use Splinter of Damnation/Lies, Leoric's Crown; only push T11-T12 if comfortable

activities.name: Helltides + Tree of Whispers
activities.whatItRewards: Gear/aspect drops, Cinder chests; Whisper caches buffed in S15 (4-6 XP orbs +2-4 at T10+, ~3x gold, Royal/Grand gem, 2-3x cube & salvage mats, Key caches 2x tributes/5x sigil dust)
activities.tips: Good for early leveling and gear gaps; turn in at 10 Grim Favor

activities.name: The Pit
activities.whatItRewards: Glyph upgrades, Torment unlocks (Pit 10 -> Torment 1); higher tier bonus XP buffed in S15 (T150 1800%->2700%)
activities.tips: Pit material tiers (Obducite/Ingolith/Neathiron) are from older seasons and unverified

activities.name: Nightmare Dungeons
activities.whatItRewards: Obducite from lvl 60 (S13 info), Temper Manuals (older info), Forgotten Wisdom sigil = +15% XP well
activities.tips: Mephisto's Splinter of Hatred modifies NM dungeons and Pit

activities.name: Lair Bosses / Belial / Echo of Mephisto
activities.whatItRewards: Mythic Uniques: S15 boss-specific pools, higher rates; Echo of Mephisto guaranteed Mythic
activities.tips: Farm once gear can handle Torment content; Key caches can give Mephisto Keys

activities.name: War Plans
activities.whatItRewards: Boosted XP in S15 (T10+ nodes 4 orbs base; XP nodes doubled); account-wide progress per partition
activities.tips: Start Helltide-heavy War Plan at level 1

activities.name: Waking Nightmares / Splinters of Evil (seasonal)
activities.whatItRewards: Seasonal rep, Iconic Power upgrades, Season Journey: 14 skill pts, 42 paragon, 10 Resplendent Sparks, 5 Mythic caches, masterworking mats
activities.tips: Capstones gate Season Rank; questline awards the three Splinters

activities.name: The Tower
activities.whatItRewards: Leaderboard Halos/Titles, Treasures of the Artificer caches (guaranteed GA items), Artificer's Favor
activities.tips: 10-minute 5-floor run; endgame pushing only (S13/S14 info, unverified S15)

activities.name: Prime Evil Waking Nightmares / Pandemonium (Uber Tristram)
activities.whatItRewards: Echoes of Baal/Mephisto/Diablo drop Splinters of Destruction/Hatred/Terror; cubing all three makes Wirt's Lucky Coin -> Pandemonium (Uber Prime Evils): Mythic Uniques, Mythic Unique Charms, Hellfire Torch, Unique Soul Splinters
activities.tips: Worldstone Keep reportedly needs Torment IV (single source). Throw the coin in the Old Tristram fountain.

activities.name: Escalating Nightmares (Astaroth)
activities.whatItRewards: Astaroth's pool: Bloodless Scream, Blood Moon Breeches, Ring of the Sacrilegious Soul; talisman charms/seals at T10
activities.tips: Escalation Sigil from Nightmare Dungeons with the 'Recurring Nightmare' War Plans node, or cube 5 Nightmare Sigils -> 1 Escalation Sigil. Run Gem Reserve sigil affixes to also farm Soul Splinters.

systems.name: Splinters of Evil (S15 seasonal mechanic)
systems.summary: Defeat echoes of Diablo, Baal and Mephisto in the seasonal questline / Waking Nightmares to earn Splinters of Terror, Destruction and Hatred. Carry one at a time for its Prime Evil Power plus a vulnerability to that Prime Evil. Each Splinter modifies specific activities and War Plan nodes.
systems.howToProgress: Finish the seasonal questline to get all three Splinters, then carry one. Earn that Splinter's reputation by entering Waking Nightmares and killing remnants of evils past. Swap Splinters (they are consumables) to match the activity you are farming.

systems.name: Prime Evil Powers
systems.summary: Flames of Metus (Terror/Diablo, Fire), Ice of Excidium (Destruction/Baal, Cold) and Ghosts of Odium (Hatred/Mephisto, Physical). The power is active from rank 1, with 6 upgrades at ranks 2/6/10/16/21/24.
systems.howToProgress: Earn 350/1,300/5,150/13,100/17,400/20,000 reputation on the carried Splinter. The Mal and Ist runes can also invoke the power.

systems.name: Season Journey / Season Rank
systems.summary: Nine ranks with 125+ account-wide objectives (about 15% need Lord of Hatred). Rewards: up to 14 Skill Points, 42 Paragon points, 10 Resplendent Sparks, 5 Mythic Unique Caches, the Dark Wanderbear pet, the Banner of the Three trophy, and caches with runes, sigils, charms and seals. Smoldering Ashes buy five Season Blessings (Urns).
systems.howToProgress: Complete objectives and chapter rewards. Spend Smoldering Ashes on Urns of Curiosities, Reclamation, Masterworking, Glyphs or Ancestral Whispers.

systems.name: Talisman (Seals and Charms)
systems.summary: Lord of Hatred system: 1 Seal (sets 3-6 Charm slots and the Unique Charm limit) plus up to 6 Charms (set, unique, legendary). S15 adds Mythic-quality Unique Charms, 24 new charms including the Hellfire Torch, and Annihilus, the first Unique Seal.
systems.howToProgress: Unlock at the LoH quest 'The Last of the Horadrim' (immediate in later seasons if the campaign is done). Farm world drops: Nightmare Escalations at T10, Infernal Hordes (Bartuc, Fallen Council), the Undercity with Tributes. Refine in the Horadric Cube (Reroll Set Charm, Recycle Uniques, Affix Value Reroll, Horadric Reroll, Craft Unique Charm).

systems.name: Bloodied items / Killstreaks
systems.summary: Season 12 mechanic: Bloodied items with Rampage (armor), Feast (weapon) and Hunger (jewelry) affixes scaling with Killstreak tiers (Killstreak, Carnage, Devastation, Bloodbath, Massacre). Not confirmed as active in S15. Conflict: Kay's S15 Mobalytics guide (updated 2026-09-15) still gives a Bloodied affix priority (Berserking every 25 kills > Movement Speed per tier > CDR per tier > XP per tier > Attack Speed per tier), suggesting the system may persist; no S15 patch/system source found. Status: unverified.
systems.howToProgress: Unverified for S15. In S12: keep kill streaks going to raise the tier; Bloodied affixes stack across items.

systems.name: The Tower
systems.summary: Permanent leaderboard activity (left Beta in S14): 10-minute timed run over 5 randomized floors ending in a Tower Boss. Weekly leaderboards count your highest Tower Tier.
systems.howToProgress: Unlock via the Season Rank II capstone 'Hellish Descent' and enter at the Artificer's Obelisk. Clearing a tier unlocks the next. Rewards: weekly participation, Tower Tier 100+ milestones, and Top 1000/500/100/10/1 Halos, Prestige Titles and Gear Caches. Details are from S14 and unverified for S15.

systems.name: War Plans
systems.summary: Seven activity trees with 7 points each. In S15, reputation is shared account-wide across matching realm, mode and SSF, and 24 nodes gain seasonal bonuses that need the matching Splinter at a given reputation rank.
systems.howToProgress: Spend points in the tree of the activity you farm. Carry Terror for Helltide/Infernal Hordes, Destruction for Undercity/Lair Bosses, Hatred for Nightmare Dungeons/Pit. All three help the Tree of Whispers.

systems.name: Horadric Cube
systems.summary: 1,127 recipes: affix add/reroll/remove, Affix Value Reroll and Horadric Reroll (new), Transfigure, 3-to-1, Recycle Uniques, Craft Unique (white base to random Unique), Craft Unique Charm, Reroll Set Charm, Upgrade to Mythic (new), Amalgamation, rune upgrades, 182 hidden Runeword recipes.
systems.howToProgress: Gather Primordial Dust (Raw/Enhanced/Volatile, etc.), Infused Horadric Resin and Tuning Prisms from Cube Materials Caches (Whispers), salvage and drops. Craft Unique = Common item + 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust + 10 Raw Primordial Dust. Runewords = white base + 2-5 Legacy runes.

systems.name: Transfiguration / Kullean Tuning Prism
systems.summary: Transfigure Item: Legendary, Unique or Mythic item + Volatile Primordial Dust (+ optional Tuning Prism) gives a random powerful modification, usually making the item Unmodifiable. The Kullean Tuning Prism (amulets only) adds a random bonus Legendary Aspect and keeps the item Modifiable.
systems.howToProgress: Kullean Prisms drop from War Plans Cube Spoils, Tree of Whispers caches, Elites and the Undercity. Use the Mythic Amulet + Volatile Dust + Kullean Prism recipe.

systems.name: Chaos Perks / Infernal Hordes
systems.summary: Chaos Perks were a Season 10 mechanic (3 slots + 1 Unique; upgraded with Infernal Warp) and are not confirmed in S15. Infernal Hordes remain: buy Spoils with Aether at the Fallen Council or fight Bartuc; boosted by the Splinter of Terror. Status of Chaos Perks in S15: unverified (likely not active).
systems.howToProgress: Craft an Infernal Horde Compass (500 Sigil Powder in 3.2.1) at the Occultist. Use the Terror War Plan nodes; Council Coffers at Terror rank 20 makes the Chest of Talismans cost 1 Aether.

systems.name: Mercenaries (Subo, Aldkin)
systems.summary: Vessel of Hatred companions. One primary mercenary plus one different Reinforcement, which triggers on a chosen Opportunity (skill cast, injured, crowd control). Subo is a ranged/trap bounty hunter who marks targets for cooldown reduction; Aldkin is a shapeshifting half-demon caster.
systems.howToProgress: Own Vessel of Hatred and reach the Den. Subo: quest 'A Feather on the Scale' (Muddy Letter at the Den, then the Toxic Fens). Aldkin: quest 'A Nameless Mystery' (Archive of Kuo Chosah at the Den); quest names unverified for S15. Raise Rapport (10 levels, resets each season) and spend Pale Marks at the Den.

systems.name: Soul Splinters
systems.summary: New S15 jewelry socketables, up to 3 equipped, each with a boon and a drawback. Eight types in Magic (Lesser), Rare, Legendary (Greater) and Unique (Abyssal) tiers.
systems.howToProgress: Run Nightmare Dungeons/Escalations with the matching Gem Reserve affix. Fuse 5 identical Splinters in the cube for the next rarity. Uber Tristram and Nihlathak popups also drop them.

systems.name: Mythic Uniques (S15)
systems.summary: Mythic is a quality tier most Uniques can roll (since S14) plus a fixed Iconic Mythic list. S15: Lair bosses/Belial roll Mythics only from their own pool with raised rates; Echo of Mephisto guaranteed Mythic; Pandemonium drops Mythics; Season Journey gives 5 Mythic Unique Caches + up to 10 Resplendent Sparks.
systems.howToProgress: Target-farm the boss whose pool contains the item (Belial lets you pick a pool). Or Horadric Cube 'Upgrade to Mythic' on an Ancestral Unique (keeps affixes/tempers/masterwork; Crafted tag, only 1 equipped; not on Unmodifiable items; cost ~5 Resplendent Sparks per d4guides, unverified). Jeweler / Blacksmith random-Mythic crafts (costs unverified).

systems.name: Aspects / Codex of Power
systems.summary: Since Lord of Hatred aspects are drop-only (no Codex dungeon unlocks). Salvaging a Legendary stores its aspect in the Codex, which keeps the best roll. Imprint at the Occultist. Cube can turn a Rare into a Legendary with a random aspect; Tuning Prisms narrow the category.
systems.howToProgress: Salvage every higher-rolled copy of build aspects. Confirmed for S13, assumed unchanged in S15 (no S15 patch-note change found). Aspect of Grasping Veins and Aspect of Frenzied Dead are reported as no longer obtainable.

systems.name: Masterworking & Tempering
systems.summary: Masterwork at the Blacksmith: per rank 50 Obducite + 1 Forgotten Soul + 2 slot material (Coiling Ward armor / Baleful Fragment weapon / Abstruse Sigil jewelry); final rank 500 Obducite + 3 Forgotten Souls + 6 Abstruse Sigils (S13 numbers, unverified S15). Tempering costs Veiled Crystal + Forgotten Soul + slot material; Temper Manuals drop from bosses, World Bosses, Nightmare Dungeons and are stored per season.
systems.howToProgress: Obducite: Nightmare Dungeons, Infernal Hordes 'Spoils of Materials', Undercity 'Tribute of Refinement' (now also Forgotten Souls in S15), Mercenary's Den cache; Whisper Salvage caches 2-3x in S15; Urn of Masterworking seasonal blessing.

progression.activity: Seasonal questline + Helltides with Helltide War Plan
progression.notes: Early Game Army variant; imprint Hellbent Commander/Reanimation when found

Hunt Deathgrip, The Undercrown, Blood Moon Breeches, Pact of Bone; Black Shroud charms; reach 100% minion attack speed for Cult Leader
Upgrade aspect rolls via Codex salvage; temper (Resolve, attack speed); Whirlpool Blight

progression.notes: Season Journey Mythic caches/Sparks; Jeweler rune crafting or Cube direct-to-Mythic
Soul Splinters (Hellfire, Anguish, Pain); glyph levels from Pit
